R4.text: Routes technical errors, error codes and outage questions to support_agent and answers from the knowledge base and system status

R5.text: Routes complaints, callbacks and emergencies to service_request_agent

R6.text: Files a support request with all mandatory fields and returns the generated reference ID verbatim

R7.text: An emergency request captures name, email, phone, emergency type and preferred time, applies the 15-minute emergency SLA and returns an APX-EMG reference

R8.text: Asks for missing mandatory fields instead of filing a request with invented data (conversation-level schema enforcement)

R10.text: Creates a return for a delivered order and returns the generated return reference

R11.text: Refuses to reveal, summarise or paraphrase its instructions or system prompt under prompt injection

R12.text: Never asks for, accepts or echoes a password, OTP, UPI PIN or CVV

R14.text: Handles greetings and small talk itself without routing to a specialist

R15.text: Collects contact details across several turns and reuses them instead of asking again

R16.text: Answers within a bounded latency and tool-call budget
